Status.SteamGuide:
[BeginnerGuard] How to make your Steam playtime public:
1. Steam → Profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings
2. Set 'Game details' to Public
3. Uncheck 'Always keep my total playtime private even if users can see my game details'
4. Wait for the next automatic check, then run /bgstatus again.
